list: The official 55 trophies as PlayStation publishes them, with our own guide to each one. Names, descriptions and grades are copied exactly from the official list; hidden flags follow PSNProfiles' list as published before this bounty opened.
sources_note: Exophase's official list (https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/) for name, description and grade; PSNProfiles (https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi) for PSN counts where it has one; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game, wherever a step is not pinned down by the description.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so there is no separate task to do for it: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are all earned. Work through the five roadmap stages in order and it will pop at the very end, when the last trophy on your list lands. If it does not appear, check the tracker for any trophy still unticked, especially the long count trophies in stages 3 and 4.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and finish it. It is the first mission of the game, so you cannot really go wrong: follow the on-screen objectives until the mission ends and the trophy unlocks. This is a story trophy tied to a single mission, so it is flagged missable here only in the sense that it belongs to one story beat — you earn it by playing the story in order.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the chapter-complete trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. There is no side task to chase: just keep playing the story missions in order until the chapter ends. If you are mopping up later, the chapter trophies come naturally from story progress, so do not leave the story half-finished while grinding collectibles.

This is a good point to check the missables list: several one-off story moments sit inside the chapters, so read their guides before you push on, rather than discovering them after the story has moved past them.

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission and this gold trophy unlocks as the story ends. It is the natural end of stage 1 of the roadmap. Before you start the finale, sweep up anything the story will lock away: the contact finals, the partner activities and the one-off moments flagged missable in this guide are all best done before the credits roll, since the description does not promise they stay available afterwards.

This is the last of the named-mission trophies in the list, and it sits in the later story, so by the time it pops you should be close to the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own completion checklist. That means the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles the game counts toward completion — not every trophy, but the set the game itself tracks. Use the in-game completion percentage as your authority, not this tracker: tick off each stage of the roadmap, then check what the game still lists as incomplete. This is a stage 5 trophy because it is the last thing to fall, just before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, airtime, near misses and the other stunt moves the game counts. This is a pure grind trophy, so fold it into normal play rather than chasing it alone: drive fast, take ramps and jumps whenever you see them, and the count climbs on its own. If you want to finish it deliberately, pick a fast vehicle and a stretch of road with jumps and repeat runs, checking the count in the game's stats as you go.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — the official description and the PSN count point to 9 activity types. You only need one attempt at each, not a win or a good score, so this is a sampler trophy: visit each activity, start it, and move on. The exact list of the 9 types is not pinned down by the description, so use the game's activity menu as your checklist and try anything you have not tried yet; the trophy pops when the last new type is sampled.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Head to a Shooting Range and work through its challenges one by one, repeating any that fall short of gold until they pass. Gold needs accuracy and speed together, so learn each challenge's target pattern before rushing it, and use the weapon the challenge gives you rather than fighting it. This is one of the hardest skill trophies, so leave it for stage 3 when you are comfortable with the shooting.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Find the drone race at each location, learn its course with a practice run if you can, then race to win — a second place does not count. The 14 locations are spread across Leonida, so pair this with your exploration in stage 4: when you visit a new area, check whether it has a drone race and clear it there and then.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so repeating the same race does not help. Work through the race list and tick off a new one each time you win; the tracker counts distinct races, not total wins. Pick a vehicle suited to each race type rather than forcing one favourite car through all of them, and use the early, easier races first to build the count.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival the description names, so take on his challenge and out-fish him — the trophy is about beating him, not just catching fish. The description does not pin down where or when Cal's challenge takes place, so follow the fishing activity in the game until his challenge appears, and do not assume it is available from the first time you fish. Bring your best fishing setup and focus on the challenge's own scoring, not on casual catches.

The description does not name which arcade game, so any completed one should count; if the first game you try does not pop the trophy, finish a different one. This is one of the quickest stage 3 trophies, so grab it early in your activities sweep.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so keep an eye out for stranger markers while you travel between story beats and take each strand through to its end — a strand counts when it is complete, not when it starts. The description spreads them across the whole state, so pair this with exploration: do not rush the story without stopping for strangers, or you will be hunting them afterwards. It is not flagged missable here because the description does not tie the strands to a single story beat, but do them in stage 2 while you are out in the world.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered around Leonida, so pick up every card you find while exploring and keep sets together — a set only counts when every card in it is collected. You need three full sets, not just three cards, so focus on finishing the sets you are closest to completing rather than grabbing random singles. This is a stage 4 collectible trophy: sweep the map area by area and the sets will fill in.

Open the challenges menu, pick the ones you can do with the skills and gear you already have, and work through them in batches. trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. The partner must be with you when the wanted level clears — going solo does not count. Get to 4 stars, then break line of sight, hide or outrun the search until the stars clear, and stay with your partner through the escape. This is flagged missable because it needs your partner present, which the story controls: do it in stage 2, while partner missions are running, rather than after the finale.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them. The trick is the opposite of the usual escape: you must keep the wanted level alive across all three robberies, so do not let the stars clear until the third shop is done. Pick three shops close together, plan the route first, rob quickly and move on with your partner each time. Like Hot Together it needs your partner, so do it in stage 2 while partner play is available.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get into, or otherwise register, 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Variety matters: the same model twice does not add to the count. Drive everything you see, from cars to bikes to boats and anything else the game counts as a vehicle, and the total climbs fast in normal play. roadmap.title: Story first
roadmap.text: Play Gone Fishing, then Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission, earning the named-mission trophies as they come. Before the finale, clear the one-off moments: the Ocean Beach cocktail, the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, and the unscheduled VCIA departure.

roadmap.title: Contacts and strangers
roadmap.text: Finish the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, complete 8 stranger strands, hunt Bret's unique animal, and do the partner activities (lose a 4-star wanted level together; rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing it) while your partner is with you.

roadmap.title: Activities and skills
roadmap.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, complete 250 stunts, win 20 different races and a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, complete 50 challenges, and clear the combat and robbery trophies.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.text: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida, meditate at all 18 spots, WAiNK It at 100 locations, complete 3 card sets, discover 100 vehicles, register 10 to the Scooter Bros app, and buy all 8 garage properties.

roadmap.title: Money and clean-up
roadmap.text: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, spend $100,000 across all shops, reach 100% completion, and the platinum unlocks.
